method: Compiled both Python fences from the lesson, executed the three-task stub, recomputed the 20-turn input-token arithmetic for 0/3/10/30 injected memories, compared output to the displayed golden, and checked statistical/cost caveats and registered references. No provider calls or billing queries were made.
limitations: The task examples and three-task fixture are constructed; they do not establish task representativeness, model performance, memory-extraction quality, retrieval quality, or product benefit.

The arithmetic is a simplified input-token model under fixed assumptions; it excludes output tokens, provider caching and prices, storage, retrieval infrastructure, retries, and human operations. No provider usage or bill was measured.

The previous table totals and printed program did not agree because the code summed the storage-token proxy while the table omitted it. The revised model separates stored item count from model input tokens; earlier values are not provider measurements.
Historical model outputs, task-level paired outcomes, scorer calibration, and original billing records were unavailable and were not reproduced.
The local checks validate code arithmetic and evidence boundaries only; they do not run a confirmatory paired evaluation or validate statistical power for a production task set.
